author: The Efficient Engineer
description:
Check out https://sendcutsend.com/efficientengineer/ to get custom parts delivered in just a few days.
----
Some of the most common structures in engineering are surprisingly inefficient. Even a simple beam carries plenty of material that isn't doing much at all. So what if we handed the problem to an algorithm instead - told it what the structure needs to do, and let it work out the best possible shape? That's exactly how topology optimization works - the field of engineering that uses algorithms to arrange material in the most efficient way possible, producing unusual but highly efficient structures.
